title: gf2-kernels-hip permanent module scaffold
description:
Create the `gf2-kernels-hip/hip/permanent/` directory scaffold and Rust FFI surface that the per-prime HIP device kernels (T23-T25) will populate.

## Background

`gf2-kernels-hip` is opt-in via Cargo feature `hip` and excluded from the default workspace build per the project's HIP conventions. This issue lands the directory structure, the C++/HIP source layout convention, and the Rust FFI shim that the host-side dispatcher (T26) will call into.

No device kernels are implemented in this issue — only the build infrastructure (HIP bindgen, build.rs invocation of `hipcc`, conditional compilation under the `hip` feature). The downstream T23/T24/T25 lands the actual kernels.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/hip/permanent/` directory exists with placeholder `.hip` source files and the build-system entry points.
- [ ] [hard] `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/build.rs` is updated to compile the new module under feature `hip`; non-`hip` builds remain unaffected.
- [ ] [hard] Rust FFI surface `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/permanent/mod.rs` declares `extern "C"` shims (no implementation yet) for the per-prime entry points.
- [ ] [hard] On a non-ROCm host, `cargo build -p gf2-algebra --release --all-features` (without `hip`) still succeeds.
- [ ] [hard] On a ROCm host, `cargo build -p gf2-kernels-hip --release --features hip` succeeds.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.
